title: Analysis code and results for lineage-selective cancer dependencies from DepMap 26Q1
description: Code, intermediate results, figures and supporting tables for the manuscript 'A selectivity-based analytical strategy for identifying lineage-selective cancer dependencies from DepMap data'. The current analysis uses DepMap 26Q1, 1,192 cancer cell lines and 467,091 gene-lineage tests, yielding 94 prioritised pairs. Input datasets are public but are not included in this archive; download instructions and input-file checksums are in the README. Version 2.2.0 adds a Hodges-Lehmann sensitivity analysis of all 9,805 significant gene-lineage pairs and an extended S9 Table. The median-based prioritisation rule remains the primary analysis; the matched HL threshold is post hoc. Version 2.3.0 adds a check of whether the lineage signal is confounded by the per-cell-line screen dynamic range of Chronos, and reports p-values in Fig 13 to two significant digits. Version 2.4.0 adds a formal test of the prioritisation thresholds (S12 Table), a comparison of the prioritised pairs with next-generation patient-derived model screens (S13 Table), and pre-specified and post hoc checks of FERMT2 in CNS/brain (S14 Table); these analyses were added after the primary results were known. Version 2.4.1 changes figure presentation only: in Fig 13 the text boxes no longer hide the lower confidence limits in panel C or data points in panel F, and panel E states the gene set of the co-dependency analysis; p-values in Figs 8 and 9 use the same notation as the other figures; and labels use British spelling. No number, table or result changed. Version 2.4.2 adds four scripts that write numbers reported in the manuscript which were previously computed only interactively or not traceable to a result file (snap23_paralogue_restriction.py, hl_discrepancies.py, fermt2_fermt1_expression.py, manuscript_extra_numbers.py) and their result files. The full pipeline was rerun from the raw inputs and reproduced all stored results, supplementary tables and figures; no existing number, table or figure changed. Version 2.5.0-prereg adds the folder preregistration/: two analysis plans frozen on 19 November 2026 before any of the analyses they describe were run (plan A: a culture-format-stratified Van Elteren procedure for lineage-dependency testing with a pre-specified simulation study; plan B: an external positive-control benchmark built by two independent AI screeners from literature), their screening materials, a documented literature search on prior procedures, seven audit reports on the drafts produced by an AI model (Claude, Anthropic) in a session separate from the one that drafted the plans (not independent human review), and SHA-256 checksums of every file (preregistration/SHA256SUMS.txt). No code, result, table or figure of the existing analysis changed.
